[1mDESCRIPTION[0m
  Manage plugins

[1mUSAGE[0m
  [36mopencode plugin <subcommand> [flags][0m

[1mGLOBAL FLAGS[0m
  [32m--help[0m, [32m-h[0m                                                          Show help information
  [32m--version[0m, [32m-v[0m                                                       Show version information
  [32m--wizard[0m                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  [32m--completions[0m [2m<bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>[0m                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  [32m--log-level[0m [2m<all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>[0m    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  [32m--print-logs[0m                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)

[1mSUBCOMMANDS[0m
  [36mlist[0m      List plugins
  [36madd[0m       Install a plugin and add it to the global configuration
  [36mcheck[0m     Check package plugins for updates
  [36mupdate[0m    Update package plugins
  [36mremove[0m    Remove a plugin from global configuration
